description.value: Dona Donair & Kebab is a Mediterranean fast-food shop in Maple Ridge serving donairs, kebab plates, falafel, shawarma, and salads from a location on Dewdney Trunk Road. It is part of the Dona Donair chain and offers an extensive menu spanning meat, fish, and vegetarian options, all made with hand-picked ingredients. Cyclists passing through Maple Ridge on Dewdney Trunk Road will find it a practical stop for a filling, hot meal.

address.value: 20398 Dewdney Trunk Rd #220, Maple Ridge, BC
